score_descriptions.total_core_hours: Total CPU core-hours of requested compute (executor_count x cores x elapsed / 3600). Uses per-job profile cores from K8s manifest, not the global executor.cores config value
score_descriptions.compute_efficiency_gb_per_core_hour: GB processed per core-hour of requested compute (higher is better)
score_descriptions.total_data_processed_gb: Sum of input data across all pipeline stages in GB
score_descriptions.pipeline_throughput_gb_per_second: Total data / wall-clock time in GB/s (higher is better)
score_descriptions.total_elapsed_seconds: Wall-clock seconds from pipeline start to final stage completion
score_descriptions.composite_qph: Queries per Hour -- median of in-stream rounds or single benchmark (higher is better)
score_descriptions.time_to_value_seconds: Wall-clock seconds from first input to queryable gold (lower is better)
score_descriptions.scale_ratio: Actual data volume / expected volume for the scale factor (1.0 = complete)
score_descriptions.maintenance_elapsed_seconds: Total seconds spent on expire_snapshots + remove_orphan_files + compaction
score_descriptions.maintenance_pct_of_pipeline: Maintenance time as percentage of total pipeline time
score_descriptions.pre_compaction_file_count: Iceberg data files before rewrite_data_files / OPTIMIZE
score_descriptions.post_compaction_file_count: Iceberg data files after rewrite_data_files / OPTIMIZE
score_descriptions.compaction_ratio: pre/post file count ratio (higher = more compaction benefit)
score_descriptions.benchmark_samples_per_query: Timed samples per query in the scored benchmark round (QpH uses the per-query median; 1 means no measured spread)
score_descriptions.qph_spread: QpH of the slowest and fastest round the per-query samples allow, and their relative range
score_descriptions.maintenance_settle_seconds: Seconds from maintenance end until a storage-bound probe query was stable, before the post-maintenance round; not counted in time_to_value
score_descriptions.maintenance_settled: True when the probe settled within the cap; false means the post round ran on unsettled storage and maintenance_value_pct is null
score_descriptions.maintenance_settle_capped: True when the settle wait reached benchmark.maintenance_settle.max_seconds
score_descriptions.maintenance_settle_verified: False when there was no pre-maintenance probe time (scale >= 50): the probes agreed with each other, which a slow plateau also does
